answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Taqleed & Fighi Schools Question ID: 2523 Country: India Title: Is taqleed nessecry or not? Please, tell me about this? Question: Is taqleed nessecry or not? Please, tell me about this? Answer ID: 2523 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1705/1501=B) Those who do not possess the requirements of ijtihad (deriving the solution of matters directly from Quran and Hadith) they must follow any imam from the Four Imams in istenbati (derivated) matters. Otherwise, Ghair Muqallidiat (not following any Imam) leads a man to atheism and disbelief according to Maulana Muhammad Hussain Sahib, the predecessor of Ghair Muqallideen. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
